content.title: About
content.content: Jagerbomb is a popular cocktail made of a shot of energy drink (usually Red Bull) dropped into a glass of Jäger‑meister liqueur. The drink is consumed quickly after the “bomb” is dropped.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The name combines the Jäger‑meister brand with the word “bomb,” referring to the rapid consumption.
It rose to fame in the early 2000s in college bars across the US and Europe.
The caffeine in the energy drink can mask alcohol’s sedative effects, increasing risk of over‑consumption.
Variations exist using rum, tequila, or even beer instead of Jäger‑meister, and different energy‑drink brands.
Some countries restrict the sale of energy drinks mixed with alcohol.

items.title: Energy boost
items.content: Caffeine and taurine in the energy drink can temporarily increase alertness and concentration.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Many energy drinks are fortified with B‑vitamins that support metabolic energy production.

items.title: Alcohol‑caffeine mix
items.content: Caffeine may mask alcohol’s depressant effects, raising the risk of intoxication and accidents.

items.title: Cardiovascular strain
items.content: The combination places extra stress on the heart, especially in people with hypertension.

items.title: Allergy to ingredients
items.content: Some individuals may react to herbal extracts in Jäger‑meister or to components of the energy drink.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: Energy drinks often contain a lot of sugar, which can contribute to weight gain and blood‑glucose spikes.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Traditionally, a shot of energy drink is dropped into a glass containing 30–40 ml of Jäger‑meister and the mixture is drunk in one swift gulp. Serve in a shot glass or small tumbler and avoid consuming more than one bomb at a time.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the Jäger‑meister bottle in a cool, dark place with the cap tightly sealed. Keep the energy drink in its original container at room temperature and consume it within a few days after opening.
